bounded_interpretations.meaning: All 171 non-null computed scores, not all 186 input rows; the exact host changed-row count and warmup counts are authoritative.

Statistical rescaling by the host-defined horizon-scaled denominator, not physical-unit conversion. The same hypothesis explicitly says raw and normalized scores are both dimensionless; the host formula includes sqrt(lookback).
bounded_interpretations.phrase: expressed in units of its own recent daily-return dispersion

limitations: Previously seen three-symbol development sample; no holdout, performance or causal comparison.
Descriptive co-ranking supports the motivation but does not identify a causal volatility/signal decomposition.
The observed real workflow is analyze/design/review with peer-error correction during design; no failed-review/revision loop occurs.
A clean final report does not erase the earlier wrong coverage expectation or prove general semantic reliability.
method: Independent source and Decimal arithmetic review; no paid reviewer call
scope: Exact final host report and adopted qualitative interpretations, not every intermediate statement
verified: Adopted specification keeps lookback and direction, adds realized-volatility normalization with the same five-observation volatility window and no return bound.
One worker calculation of the normalized specification is attributed to the designer. Baseline comparisons use the complete pre-existing frozen baseline inspection, not a second worker execution.
171 non-null computed scores change; 15 warmup rows remain excluded. Eligible counts, next-close counts and exclusions stay unchanged.
Designer explicitly replaces the analyst's expected coverage loss with inspected unchanged coverage in both rationale and finding disposition.
Both raw and normalized scores are dimensionless. The report states exact denominator SD times sqrt(lookback) and distinguishes magnitude changes from units.
No claim that normalized dispersion compressed or comparability improved is made; those remain unproven motivations.
No alpha, superiority, systematic-risk removal, corporate-action identification, fills or tradability is established.
